commands.cmd:
B="$HOME/.local/share/codex-ecosystem/poppler-26.09.0/downloads"
A="$B/poppler-26.09.0.tar.xz"
SIG="$A.sig"
KEY="$B/poppler-key.asc"
[ -f "$A" ] && [ -f "$SIG" ] && [ -f "$KEY" ] || { echo "POPPLER_SIGNATURE_FAIL: retained archive, signature or key missing"; exit 1; }
a=$(sha256sum < "$A" | cut -d' ' -f1)
stackpin=$(python3 -c "import json;print([x['source_pin'] for x in json.load(open('manifests/stack.json'))['components'] if x['id']=='poppler'][0])") || exit 1
srcpin=$(python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('blueprints/convergence-practice/wsl-document-ingestion/sources.json'))['poppler']['archive_sha256'])") || exit 1
fpr=$(python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('blueprints/convergence-practice/wsl-document-ingestion/sources.json'))['poppler']['publisher_fingerprint'])") || exit 1
D=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1
trap 'rm -rf "$D"' EXIT
GNUPGHOME="$D" timeout 15 gpg --batch --no-default-keyring --import "$KEY" > /dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "POPPLER_SIGNATURE_FAIL: key import failed"; exit 1; }
GNUPGHOME="$D" timeout 15 gpg --batch --no-default-keyring --status-fd 1 --verify "$SIG" "$A" > "$D/status.log" 2> "$D/err.log"
grc=$?
good=$(grep '^\[GNUPG:\] GOODSIG ' "$D/status.log")
valid=$(grep '^\[GNUPG:\] VALIDSIG ' "$D/status.log")
trust=$(grep -o '^\[GNUPG:\] TRUST_[A-Z]*' "$D/status.log")
if [ "$grc" -eq 0 ] && [ -n "$good" ] && printf '%s\n' "$valid" | grep -q "^\[GNUPG:\] VALIDSIG $fpr " && [ "$a" = "$stackpin" ] && [ "$a" = "$srcpin" ]; then
  echo "POPPLER_SIGNATURE_OK | gpg --verify exit $grc | VALIDSIG fingerprint == sources.json publisher_fingerprint | archive sha256 == stack source_pin == sources.json archive_sha256"
else
  echo "POPPLER_SIGNATURE_FAIL | gpg --verify exit $grc | archive sha256 $a | stack source_pin $stackpin | sources.json $srcpin"
  cat "$D/status.log"
  exit 1
fi
echo "$good"
echo "$valid"
echo "$trust (temporary keyring: trust comes from the pinned fingerprint, not the web of trust)"
echo "archive sha256 $a"

commands.cmd:
B="$HOME/.local/share/codex-ecosystem/poppler-26.09.0/downloads"
D=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1
trap 'rm -rf "$D"' EXIT
cp "$B/poppler-26.09.0.tar.xz" "$D/tampered.tar.xz" || exit 1
python3 -c "import sys;p=sys.argv[1];b=bytearray(open(p,'rb').read());i=len(b)//2;b[i]^=0x01;open(p,'wb').write(b)" "$D/tampered.tar.xz" || exit 1
GNUPGHOME="$D" timeout 15 gpg --batch --no-default-keyring --import "$B/poppler-key.asc" > /dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "POPPLER_TAMPER_CONTROL_FAIL: key import failed"; exit 1; }
GNUPGHOME="$D" timeout 15 gpg --batch --no-default-keyring --status-fd 1 --verify "$B/poppler-26.09.0.tar.xz.sig" "$D/tampered.tar.xz" > "$D/status.log" 2> "$D/err.log"
grc=$?
bad=$(grep '^\[GNUPG:\] BADSIG ' "$D/status.log")
good=$(grep -c '^\[GNUPG:\] GOODSIG ' "$D/status.log")
if [ "$grc" -eq 1 ] && [ -n "$bad" ] && [ "$good" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "POPPLER_TAMPER_CONTROL_OK | gpg --verify of a copy with one flipped byte exits $grc | GOODSIG lines: $good"
  echo "$bad"
else
  echo "POPPLER_TAMPER_CONTROL_FAIL | gpg --verify exit $grc | GOODSIG lines: $good"
  exit 1
fi
